description: DeepSeek-only candidate text feature schemas for comparing new PPO-facing text signals before expensive DRL runs.

schemas.name: literature_top_12
schemas.purpose: Literature-backed financial text features: tone, uncertainty, forward-looking guidance, risk specificity, financial constraints, readability, and numeric evidence.

features.name: financial_negative_tone
features.meaning: Finance-specific negative or pessimistic language supported by document evidence.

features.name: financial_positive_tone
features.meaning: Finance-specific positive or optimistic language supported by document evidence.

features.name: uncertainty_modal_intensity
features.meaning: Uncertainty, weak modal, conditional, or ambiguous language.

features.name: forward_looking_guidance_direction
features.meaning: Direction of forward-looking statements, guidance, outlook, or management expectations.

features.name: risk_factor_specificity
features.meaning: Specific, company-relevant risk disclosure rather than generic boilerplate.

features.name: litigation_regulatory_risk
features.meaning: Litigation, regulatory, antitrust, tax, compliance, or government action risk.

features.name: financial_constraint_liquidity_stress
features.meaning: Text evidence of funding constraints, liquidity pressure, refinancing risk, covenant pressure, or dividend omission risk.

features.name: earnings_release_manager_tone
features.meaning: Manager optimistic versus pessimistic tone in earnings-release or performance discussion language.

features.name: readability_obfuscation_risk
features.meaning: Complex, hard-to-read, vague, or obfuscating disclosure language.

features.name: numeric_fundamental_evidence_density
features.meaning: Density of useful numeric operating, earnings, margin, cash-flow, balance-sheet, or guidance evidence.

features.name: macro_downside_pressure
features.meaning: Macro text evidence of rates, credit, inflation, volatility, labor, energy, or market downside pressure.

features.name: text_signal_confidence
features.meaning: Confidence that the extracted text signal is specific, timely, and not boilerplate.

schemas.name: v1_baseline_10
schemas.purpose: Current first-pass text-to-numerical feature set used by the Mistral panel.

features.name: text_relevance_to_portfolio
features.meaning: Decision relevance for the ticker or portfolio.

features.name: sentiment_direction
features.meaning: Overall financial tone.

features.name: price_impact_direction
features.meaning: Expected directional pressure from document evidence.

features.name: risk_intensity
features.meaning: Downside risk intensity.

features.name: uncertainty_intensity
features.meaning: Uncertainty, conditionality, or unclear outlook.

features.name: opportunity_intensity
features.meaning: Upside, growth, margin, demand, buyback, or dividend opportunity.

features.name: forward_looking_intensity
features.meaning: Guidance, outlook, expectations, or future-looking language.

features.name: earnings_guidance_impact
features.meaning: Impact of earnings, revenue, EPS, margins, or guidance.

features.name: macro_financial_conditions_impact
features.meaning: Impact of rates, credit, inflation, volatility, labor, energy, or broad macro conditions.

features.name: company_event_risk_impact
features.meaning: Impact of legal, regulatory, supply-chain, demand, margin, or company-specific event risk.

schemas.name: investor_operator_12
schemas.purpose: Analyst-style operating business drivers: revenue, margin, cash flow, debt, guidance, and management tone.

features.name: revenue_momentum
features.meaning: Evidence that revenue or demand is accelerating or weakening.

features.name: margin_pressure
features.meaning: Cost inflation, pricing weakness, mix pressure, or margin compression.

features.name: cash_flow_quality
features.meaning: Quality of cash conversion, working capital, free cash flow, or accrual pressure.

features.name: balance_sheet_stress
features.meaning: Debt, liquidity, refinancing, leverage, covenant, or solvency pressure.

features.name: capital_return_support
features.meaning: Dividend, buyback, or shareholder-return support from the document.

features.name: guidance_revision
features.meaning: Direction of management guidance or outlook revision.

features.name: demand_strength
features.meaning: Evidence about customer demand, volume, orders, traffic, or installed base.

features.name: pricing_power
features.meaning: Ability to raise prices or defend price/mix against competition.

features.name: cost_inflation_pressure
features.meaning: Input, labor, logistics, energy, or financing cost pressure.

features.name: legal_regulatory_risk
features.meaning: Litigation, regulatory, antitrust, tax, compliance, or government action risk.

features.name: management_confidence
features.meaning: Management confidence versus caution in forward-looking statements.

features.name: valuation_reset_risk
features.meaning: Risk that valuation assumptions reset due to rates, growth, margins, or risk premium.

schemas.name: risk_control_8
schemas.purpose: PPO risk-control signals that may work better as constraints or turbulence overlays than raw alpha features.

features.name: liquidity_funding_stress
features.meaning: Cash, funding, refinancing, credit-market, or short-term liquidity stress.

features.name: leverage_refinancing_risk
features.meaning: Debt load, maturity wall, floating-rate exposure, or refinancing risk.

features.name: litigation_regulatory_risk
features.meaning: Legal, regulatory, tax, compliance, or government intervention risk.

features.name: supply_chain_risk
features.meaning: Supply, logistics, component, inventory, production, or delivery risk.

features.name: demand_slowdown_risk
features.meaning: Demand slowdown, customer weakness, churn, order pressure, or volume risk.

features.name: margin_compression_risk
features.meaning: Margin pressure from costs, mix, pricing, competition, or operating deleverage.

features.name: macro_tightening_risk
features.meaning: Rates, inflation, credit, volatility, oil, labor, or broad macro tightening risk.

features.name: boilerplate_risk_noise
features.meaning: Risk language looks generic or repeated rather than new/actionable.

schemas.name: source_quality_8
schemas.purpose: Feature controls that separate semantic signal from source quality, boilerplate, and extraction confidence.

features.name: evidence_specificity
features.meaning: Specific, document-grounded evidence rather than vague language.

features.name: numeric_evidence_density
features.meaning: Amount of useful numeric financial evidence.

features.name: forward_looking_density
features.meaning: Amount of useful forward-looking content.

features.name: boilerplate_intensity
features.meaning: Generic repeated disclosure or legal boilerplate intensity.

features.name: ticker_specificity
features.meaning: How directly the document is tied to a specific ticker instead of broad market context.

features.name: timestamp_confidence
features.meaning: Confidence that the timestamp is decision-usable.

features.name: source_reliability
features.meaning: Reliability of the source for investment evidence.

features.name: extraction_confidence
features.meaning: LLM confidence that the extracted numbers are supported by text.

schemas.name: ppo_state_compact_7
schemas.purpose: Compact PPO-facing state intended to reduce noisy dimensions before training.

features.name: text_alpha_direction
features.meaning: Net investable directional evidence after balancing positives and negatives.

features.name: text_downside_risk
features.meaning: Net downside risk intensity.

features.name: text_uncertainty
features.meaning: Uncertainty and conditionality of the evidence.

features.name: text_macro_stress
features.meaning: Macro or cross-asset stress relevant to the ticker/portfolio.

features.name: text_earnings_pressure
features.meaning: Earnings, revenue, margin, or guidance pressure.

features.name: text_balance_sheet_stress
features.meaning: Leverage, liquidity, funding, working-capital, or solvency pressure.

features.name: text_signal_confidence
features.meaning: Confidence that the text signal is real, timely, and not boilerplate.
